item.title: “Axar Patel ko aur kya karna hoga”- Aakash Chopra slams BCCI for putting all-rounder in Grade C in latest central contract list
item.description: Former India cricketer Aakash Chopra has questioned the injustice done to India all-rounder Axar Patel, after the T20I vice-captain was placed in Grade C in the recent BCCI central contracts list for the 2025-26 season. The A+ bracket has been eliminated under the BCCI's redesigned central contracts framework, which now places Grade A as the highest tier. item.description: Former Pakistani spinner Saqlain Mushtaq has taken offence to comments made by former Indian cricketers ahead of the upcoming India v Pakistan T20 World Cup 2026 clash. item.title: WATCH- “He’s the best player I’ve ever seen”- Jos Buttler on 14-year-old Vaibhav Sooryavanshi
item.description: England wicketkeeper-batter Jos Buttler made a huge declaration about the 14-year-old Indian wonderkid Vaibhav Sooryavanshi and called the teenager “the best player I’ve ever seen”. Buttler’s words came after Sooryavanshi hammered 175 in the final of India’s U19 World Cup 2026 won over England in Harare, Zimbabwe. item.title: Harshit Rana likely to miss majority of IPL 2026 after undergoing knee surgery- Report
item.description: The Kolkata Knight Riders (KKR) franchise find themselves in hot soup after it has been reported that ace pacer Harshit Rana is likely to miss either the entire IPL 2026 or the majority of the season after he underwent knee surgery recently. Rana was part of the Indian T20 World Cup 2026 squad, but suffered a knee injury in their warm-up game against South Africa in Navi Mumbai.
